method: Visually match all three runtime-HD states to structures-atlas-05 second row (normal, damaged, captured left to right).
stateEvidence: Normal is a patchwork canvas A-frame hut, open front lean-to awning over bedding, left pot in stone ring, right-front pot/sack and small supply crate, right-side stacked short logs. Damaged is collapsed torn canvas with poles, scattered timber and fallen containers; no flag. Captured is intact, same base identity, with small gold, red and blue cloth ties along roof ridge. No state has a flag or invented military emblem.
